summary: Houston plays at Milwaukee without both centers (Sengun and Adams out); Washington's No. 1 pick Dybantsa is questionable to debut at Cleveland; Josh Jacobs is back as Green Bay's lead back for Thursday behind a banged-up line.

NBA|4433192|3pm.note: Rotowire names Eason as a likely beneficiary of Sengun's absence, and more minutes give him more 3-point attempts at a 0.5 line.

NBA|3934672|ra.note: Brunson is in heavy scoring mode (28 shots vs Orlando, says the offense falls on him), but Alvarado's absence could add on-ball minutes; no clear edge.

detail.script: A competitive spread (Knicks -3.5) should keep him on the floor for a full workload.

CFB-week.summary: Midweek slate of four Group of Five games: Kennesaw State at Middle Tennessee and Jacksonville State at New Mexico State on Wednesday, then FAU at North Texas (UNT -13.5, total 77.5, ESPN) and Troy at James Madison on Thursday. No reputable odds page had posted player prop lines for any of the four games when checked, so nothing was screened.

NBA-GS-at-MIN-1029.summary: Three searches turned up no current (Oct 2026) injury report, beat-writer update or rotation news for this game; results were all from past seasons. The only current status information is the app's own injury feed (MIN without Edwards and DiVincenzo; GS without Porzingis, Butler and Moody, with Lendeborg questionable), which this research could not independently confirm or add to.

NBA-HOU-at-MIL-1029.summary: Houston is without both centers: Alperen Sengun (lower-back soreness, his first missed game of the season) and Steven Adams (soleus strain, out a week or two), so Clint Capela and Tari Eason are in line for more minutes and the frontcourt rebounding is spread across Durant, Smith and Thompson. Marcus Smart (forearm) is questionable. Milwaukee lists no injuries and its usual five should start.

NBA-WSH-at-CLE-1028.summary: Washington is without Justin Champagnie (foot) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, re-evaluation in four weeks). No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa (ankle, hurt in the preseason finale) is listed out in the feed but questionable in its note, and his coach had called it a short absence. If he returns, Kyshawn George's minutes and touches are the most exposed. Searches found no fresh Oct 28 reports for either team, and Cleveland lists no injuries.

fix.summary: Quick check on Josh Jacobs before Thursday night (Panthers at Packers).

NBA-DET-at-NY-1028.summary: Unbeaten Detroit (3-0) visits 0-3 New York without Jalen Duren (hamstring, re-eval ~Nov 8-9); Ausar Thompson (ankle) and Isaiah Joe (hip) are questionable, so Daniss Jenkins likely starts again and John Collins keeps soaking up center minutes behind Paul Reed. Market has Knicks -3.5 with the total up a point to 219.5; the Knicks' offense and bench are struggling and Brunson is carrying the scoring load.

NBA-POR-at-LAL-1028.summary: The Lakers (3-0) are 2.5-point home favorites over Portland (2-0), and the total has climbed to about 236.5, up from 228.5 in an earlier preview, so books expect a fast, high-scoring game. The Lakers play the Clippers the next night, but a close spread makes it less likely that starters sit late. Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe, Scoot Henderson (ankle) and Branden Carlson (concussion) are questionable, and Jrue Holiday and Toumani Camara should defend Doncic and Reaves.

NBA-SAC-at-SA-1028.summary: Spurs are 18.5-point home favorites over an 0-3 Kings team missing Keegan Murray (10-14 days), Dylan Cardwell and Maxime Raynaud, so blowout risk caps Spurs starters' minutes (Wembanyama played only 32 in a 4-point loss to Houston). With three frontcourt players out, Sacramento's remaining minutes go to Achiuwa, who started and played 39 minutes Sunday, and to Sabonis. Harris is out again for San Antonio, but the three-guard starting five Mitch Johnson planned all along stays in place.
